test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Rahul has 12 bananas. He sells x of them at a profit of 20% and the rest at a loss of 20%. He makes a profit of 10% on the entire outlay. Find the value of x.
solution:
**Given:**

Total bananas = 12

Bananas sold at 20% profit = x

Bananas sold at 20% loss = 12 - x

Overall profit % = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling Price (SP) - Cost Price (CP)

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100

Overall Profit = Total SP - Total CP

Overall Profit % = (Overall Profit / Total CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

Let CP per banana be ₹1.

Total CP = ₹12.

SP of x bananas at 20% profit = x × (1 + 20/100) = x × 1.2 = 1.2x

SP of (12 - x) bananas at 20% loss = (12 - x) × (1 - 20/100) = (12 - x) × 0.8 = 9.6 - 0.8x

Total SP = 1.2x + 9.6 - 0.8x = 0.4x + 9.6

Overall Profit % = 10%

10 = ((0.4x + 9.6) - 12) / 12 × 100

⇒ 10 × 12 = (0.4x - 2.4) × 100

⇒ 120 = 40x - 240

⇒ 120 + 240 = 40x

⇒ x = 360 / 40

⇒ x = 9

**∴ The value of x is 9.**
